verses.text: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him. But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend. We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.
Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him. Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”
When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”

Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honourable in the sight of all men. If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men. Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”
Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you.
But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you, bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.
Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice. And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
Bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you. But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?” Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.”
As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.
He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.
Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, and whose confidence is in the LORD.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you. In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”
When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.
Not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
Casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

At my first defence, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them. But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.
Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed, says the LORD who has mercy on you.
It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.
We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair; pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble. Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
A faithful friend is a strong defence. He who has found him has found a treasure. There is nothing that can be taken in exchange for a faithful friend. His excellency is beyond price.
Forgive your neighbour the hurt that he has done, and then your sins will be pardoned when you pray.
Come to me, all you who labour and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

messages.text: Jesus was betrayed by a friend with a kiss. He knows exactly how this feels.
Your hurt is real. God does not ask you to pretend it did not happen.
Forgiveness is not saying it was all right. It is refusing to let it poison your heart.
Forgiveness can take time. Begin by asking God to help you want to forgive.
People may fail you, but God never will.
You can forgive and still set healthy boundaries. Love does not require you to be unsafe.
Bring your anger to God in prayer. He can handle it better than anyone.
Joseph's brothers sold him, yet God turned their evil into good. He can do the same here.
Do not let one person's betrayal convince you that no one can be trusted.
Leave justice to God. He sees everything, and He is fair.
Pray for the one who hurt you, even if all you can say is, Lord, deal with them in Your mercy.
Your worth is not decided by how others treat you. God has already declared you precious.
From the Cross, Jesus prayed, Father, forgive them. He can give you the grace to do the same.
Healing from betrayal is slow. Be patient with your heart.
Peter denied Jesus, and Jesus restored him with love. Grace is bigger than betrayal.
Talk to a trusted friend or a priest. You do not have to carry this alone.
Bitterness hurts the one who carries it most. Ask God to lift it from you.
God is a faithful friend who sticks closer than a brother.
You can grieve the relationship you thought you had. That is part of healing.
Do not repay evil with evil. Overcome evil with good, and leave the rest to God.
The Sacrament of Confession can heal the wounds of anger and resentment in your own heart.
Trust may be broken, but your heart can still be whole in God.
Even if your father and mother forsake you, the Lord will take you in.
Mary watched her Son be abandoned by His friends. She will stay with you.
When you remember the hurt, say: Jesus, I give this to You.
Betrayal can teach wisdom. Ask God to show you who is safe to trust.
Your kindness was not foolish. It was Christlike, even if it was not returned.
Do not let this make you hard. Let it make you wise and still gentle.
God's love for you has not changed, no matter how others have changed.
Forgiving does not mean forgetting. It means handing the debt to God.
Seventy times seven: Jesus knows forgiveness is a journey, not one moment.
You are allowed to step back and protect yourself while you heal.
Write a letter to God about what happened. You do not need to send it anywhere else.
Saint Thomas More was condemned unjustly, yet he hoped to meet his judges one day in heaven.
When others speak against you, let God be your defender.
Hold on to the friends who have stayed faithful. Thank God for them.
Pray the Our Father slowly, especially: as we forgive those who trespass against us.
Your heart can love again. Betrayal does not get the final word.
Ask the Holy Spirit to heal the memory, so it hurts a little less each day.
God sees the tears you cried in secret. He will reward your faithfulness.
Even Jesus' closest friends ran away, yet He still called them friends.
You did not deserve this. God grieves with you.
Revenge never heals. Mercy does, slowly and surely.
Let God rebuild what was broken, in His way and His time.
The Lord is your rock and your fortress. Stand on Him.
Someday this will be a story of how God carried you through.
You are not defined by what was done to you. You are defined by God's love.
Peace is possible again. Ask Jesus for His peace, which surpasses all understanding.
Today, choose one act of kindness toward yourself. You deserve care too.
Rest tonight in the faithful love of God, who will never betray you.
